title: Birth, family and beginning trumpet with New Orleans teachers
summary: Bentley gives his birth year (1924), says no parents played music, started trumpet at about 14, and names teachers born in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: George Buck's latest record. First of all, I'd like to know your name. Bentley, Joseph Bentley. Joseph Bentley. And do you remember the year that you were born? In 1924. And do you know the actual date of your birth? 21st of February. And did any of your parents play music? No. Or anybody in the family? No, no, no. I'm Laurence Juan. Oh, yes. Laurence with us in the family. And what age did you start playing trumpet? I was about 14 years of age. You were about 14 years of age when you started playing. And did you have any formal teaching? Or did you have any teachers at all? Mm-hmm. Who were they? Do you remember? Oh, Vermont Victor, Eddie Morgan, and several others.
Yeah. They were born in New Orleans.
